title: The Lipschitz push-forward of 3.6 is the classical push-forward for differentiable maps
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), Differentiable ℝ f → IsLipschitzPushforward X f S → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn V n) (η : TestFormOn U n), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → S ω = X η
